notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
🛠️ Update 0.4.0 – “Order and Hell”
“Chaos is over. Order begins.
Safety is gone. Fear takes its place.”

📦 AutoStash System – Chaos, Finally Conquered
The long-awaited Auto Inventory Sorting System is here!
If you're near a PlotPole and have storage chests placed, your items will now be automatically sorted and stored with zero effort.

🔹 How it works:
Use Stash All to instantly transfer all items from your inventory:

The system searches for matching items already inside chests and stacks them accordingly.

No UI. No dragging. Just logic and speed.

No PlotPole nearby? No problem.

If you have a matching item in your inventory and in a chest, just hit Spacebar, and it'll be transferred automatically.

🔹 Advanced Features:
Want to keep certain items with you? → Set exceptions inside your PlotPole. For example: “Keep Medkits, stash everything else.”

If there's no room or no matching item sample in any chest, → The excess items will be dropped at your feet. Nothing is lost.

After sorting, the system shows you a detailed log of how many items were moved.

✅ Say goodbye to endless clicking.
Now it's fast. Smart. Satisfying.

🧠 Loot System Overhaul – Finally Makes Sense
No more grenades in toilets.
No more car doors in sinks.

✨ What’s new:
All loot is now contextual and realistic:

Weapons → Police stations, military zones

Medicine → Hospitals, medkits

Food → Kitchens, basements, fridges

Tools → Garages, tool racks

Junk → Drawers, cabinets, trash bins

Each container has its own curated loot table, matched to its real-world function.

➡️ More immersion.
➡️ More logic.
➡️ More believable survival.

“Even finding a screwdriver finally makes sense.”

🔐 Door Upgrades – Now with Metal Security
You can now upgrade wooden doors to metal doors, bringing:

Higher resistance to attacks

Improved protection from the outside

A strong, secure look that screams survivor

🔩 New Crafting Material: Nails
Starting with 0.4.0, building any structure or base piece
will now require nails along with wood or other resources.

Real building begins now.

☣️ Contaminated Zones – Taste of Terror
This update introduces the first sample of toxic areas,
a preview of what’s to come in future versions.

👁‍🗨 What you’ll find:
A sealed-off mine, packed with:

Rare loot

Aggressive enemies

Mutants

Pitch darkness

Entry requirements:

Respirator / gas mask – enter without it and you’ll die in seconds.

Light source – without it, you’re blind.
And something is watching in the dark...

And this is just the beginning.
Mines, abandoned buildings, bunkers, dungeons...
True survival is about to begin.

🔧 Ongoing Development
This is a milestone update, but not the final step. Here's what's next:

More varied and deadly contaminated zones

Development of special gear like hazmat suits, filters, detectors, tactical lights

Enhanced AI that reacts to light, sound, and smell

🧪 Final Notes
Update 0.4.0 delivers:

✅ Order to your inventory
✅ Realistic and logical looting
✅ Fear that lingers long after you log out

And the best part?

Hell hasn’t even started yet.

notes.title: Update 0.3.9
notes.notes:
🧭 PostApo – Alpha Update 0.3.9
⚙️ "Stability, Smoothness, and a Better Experience for Everyone"
Hey there, survivors! 💀
Update 0.3.9 is the result of a deeper optimization phase, built not only on internal testing, but—most importantly—on your feedback. The goal was to increase FPS, smooth out performance drops, and keep the immersive PostApo atmosphere, even on weaker machines.

🛠️ What’s Changed?
🔧 Graphics & Performance Optimizations
    • Refined visibility distances and LODs for trees, fog, and distant objects
    • Simplified some heavy post-processing effects without sacrificing atmosphere
    • Reworked structure of all default graphic profiles (Low → Epic)
    • Improved GPU and CPU usage – your graphics card now “knows it needs to work,” even on lower settings

📈 Real-world performance gains
Test system: Ryzen 5 3600, RX 6700 XT, 32 GB RAM
Profile	Before Optimization	After Optimization
High/Epic	45–50 FPS	65–75 FPS
Balanced Mix	~55 FPS	70–80 FPS stable
➡️ The game now runs smoother without any significant quality loss.

🖥️ Recommended Graphics Presets
🔻 Low – for lower-end systems
💻 i3/i5 4th gen, Ryzen 3, GTX 1050, RX 560, 8–12 GB RAM
Setting	Value
Resolution	1280×720 / 1920×1080
Screen %	100%
Anti-Aliasing	FXAA
Textures	Medium
Shadows	Low
Post-Processing	Low
Foliage	Low
Effects	Low
View Distance	Medium
FSR	OFF
🎯 Performance: 40–60 FPS

🟡 Medium – for standard PCs
💻 Ryzen 5 2600, i5 9th gen, GTX 1660, RX 580, 16 GB RAM
Setting	Value
Resolution	1600×900 / 1080p
Screen %	100%
Anti-Aliasing	FXAA
Textures	High
Shadows	Medium
Post-Processing	Medium
Foliage	Medium
Effects	Medium
View Distance	High
FSR	OFF
🎯 Performance: 55–80 FPS

🔵 High – for performance systems
💻 Ryzen 5 3600, i5 11th gen, RX 6600 / RTX 3060, 16–32 GB RAM
Setting	Value
Resolution	1080p
Screen %	100%
Anti-Aliasing	FXAA / TAA
Textures	Epic
Shadows	High
Post-Processing	Medium–High
Foliage	Medium–High
Effects	High
View Distance	High
FSR	Optional (Quality)
🎯 Performance: 70–90 FPS

🔴 Epic – for high-end setups
💻 Ryzen 7 5800X, i7 12700K, RTX 3080 / RX 7900 XTX, 32 GB RAM+
Setting	Value
Resolution	1920×1080 / 1440p / 4K
Screen %	100%
Anti-Aliasing	TAA / TSR
Textures	Epic
Shadows	Epic
Post-Processing	Epic
Foliage	Epic
Effects	Epic
View Distance	Epic
FSR	Recommended: Quality / Balanced
🎯 Performance: 70–170+ FPS

✅ When Should You Enable AMD FSR?
✨ We recommend enabling FSR especially when:
    • You're playing at 1920×1080, 1440p, or 4K
    • Your GPU is reaching its performance limit on higher settings
    • You prefer higher FPS even at the cost of some softness in image quality
GPU	Recommended FSR Mode
RX 6600 / RTX 2060	Quality
RX 6700 XT / RTX 3060 Ti	Quality / Balanced
RX 6800 / RTX 3080	Balanced / Auto
RX 7900 XT / RTX 4070 Ti	Ultra Quality / Off (plenty of raw power)

💬 Final Words
Thank you for playing and testing!
This update is all about smooth gameplay, accessibility, and comfort, no matter what hardware you’re using.
Your performance = our motivation. 💛
The next update will be about content, not numbers — but today we’ve laid the groundwork for a better experience across the board.
Stay alive –
The PostApo Dev Team

notes.title: Update 0.3.8

🔧 Bug Fixes:

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.6

✔ No more short, hunched-over character! Now you play as a muscular hero with hair, who fears nothing.
✔ Weapon handling animations are improved – more realistic grip and stance.
✔ Idle stance has been fixed – no more awkward arms sticking out, your character now stands naturally with hands at their sides.

✔ Bulletproof vest removed – it didn’t match the new model and is being redesigned!
🗺 Improved Loot & Game World

✔ Barn and house filled with loot – more locations to explore!

This update completely changes the player character, giving you a better survival experience.
Thank you for your feedback and support! 💖

FussyCraft & Fussyland

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.5
notes.notes:
🔥 PostApo – Alpha 0.3.5 | Multiplayer Fixes & Gameplay Improvements 🔥
Survivors! We are bringing you another important update, focused on multiplayer stability, game mechanics, and balance changes! Let’s dive into the details:
✅ BUG FIXES
    • Small objects from barrels were falling under pallets → Fixed 
    • Flags were not displaying correctly in multiplayer → Fixed 
    • Torch durability has been increased, meaning it now decays more slowly 
    • Boxing sound effect updated 
    • Farms can no longer be destroyed with fists 
    • Reduced the chance of a dead mutant spawning another mutant 
🔧 GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
    • Barrels now make a hit sound when struck 🔥 
    • Barrels now play a destruction sound when destroyed 
    • Increased health for all construction materials (wood, stone, metal) by 2x – structures are now harder to break 
    • Brick pallets now produce sound when hit and destroyed 
    • Large wooden cages now play sounds when struck and destroyed 
    • When an enemy or mutant dies, their body will now disappear after 60 seconds and leave a loot bag instead 💀 
    • Fixed an issue where enemies killed by punches would sometimes disappear without animation 
    • Minimized ragdoll desynchronization in multiplayer – dead bodies should now match the host’s location more accurately 
🔜 NEXT UPDATE PLANS:
    • Further optimization of ragdoll physics in multiplayer 
    • Balancing mutant respawns to avoid excessive encounters 
💀 Thank you for your feedback! See you in the Zone!

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.4
notes.notes:
Survivors! We bring you another major update 0.3.4, improving the trading system, crafting, and introducing new resources. This update enhances gameplay smoothness and balance! 🚀💀
✅ BUG FIXES
🔹 Arrows duplicated in the air → Fixed. Arrows now decay after 60 seconds if not picked up.
🔹 Monsters got stuck on euro pallets → Fixed. If you break a barrel with a spider, the spider now moves correctly.
🔹 Indestructible buildings and objects with fists → Work in progress! Currently, fists can still break objects that should be more resistant. This will be resolved in future updates.
🔹 Unbalanced melee weapon damage → Fixed. Melee weapon damage has been adjusted to match their type and material.
🔹 Fixed light button detection → The first interaction always triggered English, now the correct language is displayed.
🔹 Trader adjustments → New trading options and correctly set prices for materials.
🔧 GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
💰 Expanded Trading System!
✔ Gold introduced as the main currency 💰.
✔ Traders now buy and sell using Gold – scrap trade remains but has been balanced.
✔ You can now trade 30 scrap for 5 iron ingots.
✔ Price balancing – materials and items now have logical value.
🔥 New Resources & Crafting
✔ Coal added to the game – will have future use in crafting.
✔ Fireplaces, furnaces, and cooking fires now generate coal when burning materials.
✔ New stone and iron deposits added to make resource gathering easier.
👕 Improved Clothing System
✔ When wearing a jacket or vest over a T-shirt, the T-shirt now automatically hides to prevent visual glitches.
🛠 Faster Crafting!
✔ Clothing crafting time reduced from 15 to 3 seconds.
✔ Crafting in the crafting bench is now significantly faster than in the inventory.
✔ Adjusted material requirements for a more balanced crafting system.
🎌 Flags Based on Player Language
✔ At the air purifier, the flag now reflects the player’s selected language.
✔ The second flag remains unchanged.

📢 WHAT'S NEXT?
🔹 Improved enemy spawn detection → No more floating enemies or weird placements.
🔹 More scrap trading options.
🔹 Mutants will attack player bases – no safe zones forever!
🔹 Vehicle improvements – correct visual synchronization of removed parts.
🔹 Network and performance optimizations.
🎯 Thank you for your support and feedback!
👀 See you in the Zone, survivors! 🚀
💀 PostApo Team 💀

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.1
notes.notes:
🔥 PostApo – Update 0.3.1 | Multiplayer & Gameplay Mechanics 🔥
Survivors, we bring you another update focusing on multiplayer improvements, crafting enhancements, and enemy behavior tweaks. 🛠️💀

🔹 What's New in Update 0.3.1?
🎮 Multiplayer Fixes & Optimizations
✔ Fixed host access to vehicles – the host can now properly enter vehicles.
✔ Fixed loot bug in multiplayer – some corpses couldn’t be looted due to ragdoll physics. A final fix is in progress, but occasional issues might still occur. We are aware of them and working on it.
✔ Improved network synchronization – multiplayer has been optimized to reduce server load.
✔ Fixed an issue where the vehicle inventory would remain open – no more ghost inventories appearing even when not near a vehicle.
✔ Client cannot drive the vehicle if the host is inside – this will be resolved in the next update.
✔ Vehicle doors cannot be removed – they are not correctly synchronized yet, so we will fix this in the next update.
✔ Any removed vehicle components do not visually disappear – this issue applies to all vehicle parts except for wheels, which disappear correctly.

⚔️ Enemy Behavior Enhancements
✔ Squatter no longer attacks after death – when it’s dead, it’s dead! ☠
✔ Squatter now reacts to attacks from behind – if you attack, it will turn around!
✔ New Threat! – Post-Death Mutation 🧟‍♂
    • After killing a squatter, there is a chance it will transform into a mutant!
✔ Mutants no longer scream after death – no more creepy post-mortem battle cries.

🔥 Crafting & Gameplay Improvements
✔ New crafting options added
✔ Items that could previously be crafted without a crafting table can now also be crafted inside one – they will consume resources directly from the crafting table's inventory.

📢 Quality of Life & UI Improvements
✔ More torches added to the tutorial section – players sometimes had trouble finding a torch at the designated location.

🔧 Technical Fixes & Optimizations
✔ The issue with language detection on light switches will be fixed – the first press always defaults to English, while the second correctly applies the selected language. We are working on a fix.
✔ New “Notebook Mode” added in video settings – drastically reduces graphical quality but significantly increases FPS on low-end PCs.

🔜 What’s Coming in Future Updates?
🔹 Mutants will attack player bases – no more hiding in safety!
🔹 Farming improvements – crafting larger fields that retain plants even after a game restart. 🌾
🔹 Vehicle adjustments – doors will be correctly removable and replicated.
🔹 Fixing ragdoll physics – corpses will stay in the same position across all multiplayer clients.
🔹 Clients will be able to drive vehicles even when the host is inside.

🎯 Thank you for your support! We look forward to your feedback! 🎯
👀 See you in the Zone, survivors! 🚀
FussyCraft

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
PostApo – Update 0.3.0 | Enhanced Tutorial, Optimizations & New Mechanics! 🎉
Survivors, we’re bringing you another major update that takes your gameplay experience to the next level! This update introduces a fully voiced tutorial, an improved air purifier system, and massive performance optimizations for a smoother and more immersive survival experience.

🆕 Enhanced Tutorial with Full Voiceover! 🎙️
✔ The tutorial now includes voice acting to guide you step by step.
✔ No more confusion at the start – the game will now clearly instruct you on what to do!

🌫️ Upgraded Air Purifier System
✔ Combining blueberries and hemp now unlocks Level 3, significantly expanding the protective zone and purifying faster!
✔ Previously, the maximum purification level was 2 – now, it’s far more efficient!

🧍 Adjustments to Player Stats on Respawn
✔ Players no longer respawn with 100% full stats – there is now a minor penalty after death.
✔ This change enhances the realistic survival experience in PostApo!

⌨️ Improved Keybinding Support – No More Issues with Czech Keyboards!
✔ The hotbar now fully supports Czech keyboards – no need to remap keys manually!
✔ Num Lock keys are now supported, so you can use them to select items.
✔ The inventory can now be opened using both TAB and "I" keys!

⚙️ Massive CPU & GPU Optimizations – More FPS for Everyone!
🔹 CPU Optimizations 💡
✔ Increased Path Optimization Interval to 0.75s, reducing CPU load by ~35%, significantly improving performance!
🔹 GPU Rendering Enhancements 🎮
✔ LOD & rendering optimizations ensure smoother transitions between object details!
✔ LOD Dither Fading enabled – for a more natural object rendering experience!
🔹 New "Notebook Mode" for Low-End PCs! 💻
✔ Added a "Notebook Mode" in video settings, allowing players to lower graphics significantly for a major FPS boost!
🔹 FSR Upscaling for Performance Boost 🔧
✔ Introduced various FSR upscaling modes to balance performance and image quality for better gameplay!

🌱 Upcoming Features in Future Updates!
✔ We’re working on farming improvements!
✔ Soon, players will be able to upgrade small fields into larger ones, which will save crops even after restarting the game!
✔ A new crafting option for larger fields is coming soon for more efficient farming!

🔜 What’s Next?
➡ Further tutorial expansions & additional quests!
➡ New gameplay mechanics & crafting improvements!
➡ Continued performance optimizations!
Thank you for your support and feedback! The Zone never sleeps – prepare for new challenges! 💀🔥
💀 PostApo Dev Team 💀

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.2.9
notes.notes:
PostApo – Update 0.2.9 | Smarter Enemies & Night Raids! 🔥
Survivors, this update takes PostApo to a whole new level. Enemies are no longer mindless puppets – they now have strategy, instincts, and will hunt you down like never before!

🔹 Dynamic Enemy & Wildlife Spawning System
✔ Enemies and animals now spawn within the player’s vicinity.
✔ Each player has their own independent spawn timer.
✔ 1 player = 4 spawns. With 10 players, up to 40 entities are active at the same time!
✔ Your base is now a safe zone!
    • While inside your base (designated plot pole area), no enemies will spawn inside.
    • But beware! We are working on implementing full-scale mutant raids in the next update! Soon, they will be able to breach your defenses and destroy everything in their way!
✔ Night mutant raids are now a real threat!
    • Players receive an alert when mutants are closing in.
    • Raids only happen during nighttime.
✔ No enemy spawns while inside a vehicle!
    • If you're in a car, enemies will not spawn near you.
✔ Mutants now react dynamically!
    • Killing a mutant may immediately spawn another in its place!
    • Mutants don’t just see you – they smell you before you even know they’re there!

🧠 Smarter AI for Enemies & Wildlife
✔ Enemies and animals can now detect you from a greater distance.
✔ Move too carelessly, and they will hear you – and hunt you down!
✔ Wildlife now behaves more realistically – animals will try to avoid danger and survive!

⚙️ Optimization & Fixes
✔ Significant FPS improvements through optimized game mechanics.
✔ Fixed several bugs related to enemy spawning.
✔ Minor environmental adjustments for better stability and performance.

🔜 What’s Coming Next?
➡ Mutants will start attacking player bases!
➡ They will be able to tear down walls and steal supplies!
➡ Further AI improvements for more realistic enemy behavior!
Thank you for your support and feedback! Together, we are making PostApo the ultimate survival experience! 🔥
💀 PostApo Team 💀

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.2.8 HotFix4
notes.notes:
🚀 PostApo – Update 0.2.8 | Multiplayer Fixes, Vehicles & New Bow! 🎯
Survivors, we have another big update packed with fixes, optimizations, and new content!
This time, we focused on multiplayer improvements, vehicle fixes, and added a brand-new weapon – the bow and arrows! 🏹
We’ve also worked on network stability for multiplayer players – fewer lags, better synchronization, and a more stable connection!

🌐 Network Fixes & Multiplayer Optimization
Multiplayer gameplay is now smoother! We’ve improved the network performance to ensure a more stable connection between the host and clients.
✅ Fixed random disconnections in multiplayer – the game no longer kicks players due to sudden connection drops.
✅ Better data synchronization between players – clients now see objects exactly as the host does.
✅ Reduced multiplayer lag – improved latency and more accurate action synchronization.
If you had issues in multiplayer before, this update should make it a lot better! 🔧

🔧 Multiplayer Fixes & Improvements
    • ✅ Fixed UV light generator sound bug – it was continuously playing in multiplayer, even when it shouldn’t.
    • ✅ Corrected UV generator light and sound replication – both host and clients now see and hear the generator properly.
    • ✅ Fixed the parking brake issue in vehicles – clients can now properly release the handbrake and drive!
    • ✅ Partially fixed vehicle loading for clients – upon first loading, the client now sees the vehicle with all its components, which are part of the vehicle’s inventory. Previously, wheels and body parts would be missing, even though they were in the inventory.
    • ⚠️ WARNING! If the host adds or removes vehicle parts, the client will not see the change until they open the vehicle inventory – we are working on a fix!
    • 🔧 We are also working on fixing vehicle engine sounds and lights – stay tuned for improvements!

🏹 New Weapon – Bow & Arrows!
    • 🎯 A new way to fight! The bow and arrows allow for silent kills, perfect for hunting or eliminating enemies without drawing attention.
    • 🔧 Current issue – sometimes, the client cannot see the host’s bow. We are working on fixing this.

💀 Enemies & AI Improvements
    • After 18:30 and around 22:00, enemies were constantly respawning, leading to FPS drops – fixed!
    • Better enemy distribution during day & night – during the day, there are fewer mutants but more survivors and animals. At night, mutants dominate the world.
    • A dynamic world where every moment matters!

🔥 What’s Next?
    • 🔹 Further multiplayer optimizations – we want the game to run even smoother!
    • 🔹 More vehicle improvements – additional vehicle types and features.
    • 🔹 New survival mechanics & crafting – expanding ways to survive and fight!
    • 🔹 Story expansion and new quests!

Thank you for being part of our journey, survivors! Your support and feedback push us forward, making PostApo an even better game. Stay tuned for more updates and prepare for the challenges of the Zone!

🔥 PostApo - Alpha Update 0.2.4 | New Radiation System! 🔥
📢 Survivors, a major update is here! This time, we're introducing a completely revamped radiation system, which will drastically impact your survival in hazardous zones!

🆕 New Indicator: Radiation ☢
From now on, radiation is a key gameplay element! You'll accumulate radiation based on your environment and clothing.
👣 How does radiation work?
    • Entering a radiation zone: The radiation gauge will start increasing. The longer you stay, the more radiation you absorb.
    • Leaving the zone: Radiation will gradually decrease over time. The higher the dose, the longer it takes to recover.
    • Dangerous limit: Once the radiation gauge reaches 50% or more, your health will start deteriorating. If you lower it below this threshold, you will stop taking damage (as long as you’re not in the radiation zone anymore).

🛡 Radiation Protection – How to Stay Safe?
Your clothing now affects how much radiation you absorb.
👕 Types of Protection:
    • No clothing: Full radiation exposure, gauge increases rapidly! ⚠️
    • Basic clothing: Slower radiation buildup but still accumulates over time.
    • Special Protective Suit (Yellow Rubber Suit): Full protection – radiation does not increase if you are wearing the full set:
        ◦ Rubber raincoat
        ◦ Rubber pants
        ◦ Gas mask

🔄 Revamped Radiation System
🚀 Previously, stepping into a radiation zone would deal damage after 15 seconds. Now, we have reworked it: ✅ Radiation must accumulate first! Health damage only starts when the radiation gauge reaches 50% or more. ✅ You can safely exit radiation zones! If you leave before hitting the critical level, you have a chance to survive without taking damage. ✅ Survival strategy is now key! You need to plan your movements, gear, and supplies carefully to escape the deadliest areas alive.

🔜 What’s Next?
🔹 Further survival system improvements – new ways to remove radiation!
🔹 More environment interactions – expanding radiation effects and mutant behavior.
🔹 Enhanced crafting system – new protective gear and survival tools!

🙏 Thank you for your support! Your feedback is essential and helps us improve PostApo with every update!
🚀 Stay tuned – more updates coming soon! 💀
💀 The PostApo Team 💀

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.4 Update Final

Patch Notes – Alpha 0.1.4 Update
Dear survivors,
We are excited to introduce the latest update of our game PostApo – Alpha 0.1.4! This update brings new mechanics, gameplay adjustments, and fresh challenges. Get ready for an even more immersive and dangerous survival experience. Read on for all the details.

New Features and Updates:
    • Compost and Farming:
        ◦ You can now produce compost using the farm (flowerpot) field, where you can grow plants. This field now saves properly! However, plant growth time, its state, and the planted crops themselves are not yet saved. Stay tuned for further updates.
    • Air Purifier and Storage:
        ◦ The air purifier’s storage has been updated: you can now only store blueberries or hemp. Other items are not allowed.
        ◦ Warning! The air purifier storage does not save its contents. Before exiting the game, make sure to remove your blueberries and hemp.
        ◦ Nearby the air purifier, close to the fuse box, lies the cooler (fridge). You can store anything inside the cooler, and its contents will save, including item states. Use it wisely!
    • Increased Danger in Villages:
        ◦ Villages have become significantly more dangerous! Be cautious when exploring these areas, as threats now lurk around every corner.
    • Air Purifier Attacks:
        ◦ Around 18:10 and between 22:00-23:00, mutants and a squatter will attack the air purifier.
        ◦ If they manage to destroy the fuse box, you will lose 0.5 zone points (e.g., your zone radius will drop from 2.5 to 2.0).
        ◦ After 60 seconds, the fuse box’s health will regenerate to 2000 HP, but if it is destroyed again, you will lose another 0.5 zone points.
        ◦ Defend your fuse box to avoid these penalties. Kill the invaders and protect your base from these raids!
    • Become a Mutant:
        ◦ You can now transform into a mutant through the military army faction.
        ◦ In the future, mutation will also be possible via infection or in the laboratory within the complex.

Work in Progress:
    • We are actively working on new anomalies, more terrifying creatures, and additional content to enrich the game world. Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

Thank you for your continued feedback and support. Your insights drive us to make PostApo a thrilling and immersive experience. Keep surviving, and as always, watch your back out there.
With gratitude,
The PostApo Team

ADD: Reworked Gravitational Spheres
Gravitational spheres have become even more terrifying and deadly anomalies:
    • If the player gets dangerously close, the sphere will pull them in, resulting in destruction and instant death.
    • The mechanics have been reworked to make them more realistic and challenging, adding tension while exploring the world.


ADD: Torch Crafting and Repairs
Torches can now be crafted and repaired, adding utility for exploration and survival.

ADD: Interactive Air Purifier
An interactive question mark near the air purifier provides essential usage instructions.
    • Includes voiceovers, with subtitles for hearing-impaired players in development.

ADD: Trial Demo – PostApo Playtest
The PostApo Playtest – Trial Demo is now available for free on Steam:
    • Players can explore the game for 120 minutes.
    • The demo excludes story elements, quests, and merchant support.

FIX: Bug Fixes
    • Numerous bugs have been resolved.
    • Work continues on fixing known issues.

WHAT’S NEXT?
Future updates will include:
    • Further story progression.
    • New quests and locations.
    • More content and bug fixes.

Update Notes for the Game
Version: 0.1.1 | Date: 17.01.2025
This update focuses on bug fixes, mechanics adjustments, and the introduction of new features to enhance the overall gaming experience. Below is a summary of changes:

Bug Fixes
    • Resolved an issue where players did not receive a flashlight upon respawning.
    • Fixed incorrect display of the multiplayer zone circle.

    • Increased player inventory weight limit to 30 kg.

notes.title: AlphaGame Update 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello to all loyal PostApo players,
I'm bringing you a major update! The highlight of this update is the transition from Unreal Engine 5.2.1 to 5.4.4. This means more improvements, better graphics, and even higher FPS in the game.

Many changes and additions have been made to the game:

New Additions:
Contaminated zones on the game map
Air purifier
Anomalies
Mutants
Enhanced weather and sunlight
Toxic seas and water, and much more
First Quest:
Quest: Find the ceramic fuses

Objective:
Find and repair the air purifier to stop the spread of radiation.

Main Task:
Search the area and find three ceramic fuses.
Possible locations:
Inside the wreck of an old car
In an abandoned shack
Near a pile of rubble close to a warning sign
Side Objectives (Optional):
Gather hemp and blueberries to speed up the Zone’s purification:
Hemp: Found on the edges of the Zone. Rare but highly effective.
Blueberries: Grow in contaminated areas with high radiation. Use a protective suit.
Risks:
Radiation gradually spreads, making exploration harder and weakening your health. Keep an eye on your exposure meter.
Beware of mutations in some areas – they will attack if you get too close.
Bonus:
If you load both hemp and blueberries into the purifier, you’ll unlock accelerated purification, which dramatically reduces the radiation level in the Zone.
Quest Outcomes:
✅ Success:

The purifier is repaired, and radiation begins to recede. Using hemp and blueberries maximizes the effect.
Rewards: Supplies (water, equipment) or a map revealing unexplored areas.
❌ Failure:

Radiation spreads to your location, reducing your health, contaminating your base, and increasing the difficulty of future missions.
Warning: Mutants in the Zone
You’re not the only one trying to survive in the Zone. Mutants, twisted by radiation and contamination, pose a deadly threat. These unpredictable creatures have their weaknesses, but never underestimate them. They can become a part of the game world and your direct adversary.

What do mutants do?
Attacks on Machines:

Mutants often target your air purifier, which can slow down the Zone’s purification process. If they get close, they can severely damage it.
Thefts:

Blueberries and hemp are rare resources that speed up Zone purification. Mutants, knowing their value, steal them from your supply tanks or base.
Raids on Bases:

If players build a base, mutants can organize raids. They break walls, destroy equipment, and steal resources, forcing players to constantly defend themselves.
Language Update
I’m adding the Czech language to the game, and it’s currently about 59% complete. I’m continuing work on the translation.

Coming Soon:
Future updates will include bug fixes, new content, and exciting new quests.

Thank you for playing,
FussyCraft

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.0.8
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

Here's an update with many fixes and added features.

ADD:
Lootable Furniture:
Kitchen cabinets, sinks, refrigerators, bathroom sinks, toilets, washing machines, etc.

New Enemies:
Zombies, hostile natives, radiation worms.

Radiation Zones:
Some areas are radioactive, while others are safe.

Dead Trees:
Harvesting dead trees will give you wood, but you'll also get a dose of radiation.
Trees provide little wood, so you'll need to destroy wooden items to gather more.
I'm working on a destruction system for interactable objects across the entire map.
For now, you can get wood, metal scrap, paper, or glass by breaking pallets, crates, and other objects.

(Note: Not all items can be broken yet, as the map is large, but I'm working on it.)

New Items:

Barrels: Break them to get apples, stones, wood, and other random loot.
Pallets of bricks: Provide stones.
Pallets of cardboard: Provide paper.
Car wrecks: Random loot.
Aggressive Animals:
Added aggressive deer. Wolves and bears are planned, as well as a radioactive scorpion.

Starting Safe Zone:
Added a spawn point in a safe zone where I'm working on traders and other services for players. You're safe in this area.

Wells:
Scattered around the map for drinking water or refilling bottles.
Other scattered items include glass, paper, pallets, and scrap materials. Collect these for resources.

Starting Weapon:
The pneumatic rifle is a basic emergency weapon! Search for better firearms or melee weapons for close combat.

FIXES:
Fixed known bugs, though not all issues are resolved yet.
If you find a bug, please share it with me so I can fix it.
I'm actively working on updates, fixes, and adding new content to the game.
Enjoy the holidays!
FussyCraft
